explanation: Matches erdosproblems.com/1196 with the positive answer (linked formal proof). There is a function o(x) → 0 such that every primitive set A ⊆ [x,∞) of naturals satisfies Σ 1/(a log a) < 1 + o(x). On ℕ, IsPrimitive (x | y implies x, y associated) means no distinct elements divide each other. The tsum is not a junk 0 here, because primitive sets have convergent Σ 1/(a log a) (Erdős). The degenerate a = 1 term (1/0 = 0) only arises for A = {1} at x = 1.
